name: GD 2.1 Physics
description: Restores 2.1 physics & bugs in GD 2.2 so legacy 2.1 levels (e.g. Warcora) are playable again.

enabled.name: Enable 2.1 Physics
enabled.description: When on, replaces 2.2 player physics with the 2.1 model. Restart the level for the change to fully apply.

physics-rate.name: Physics Step Rate
physics-rate.description: fps-locked-21 = 4 physics steps per frame like 2.1 (FPS-dependent). fixed-240 = 2.2 default. fps-locked-21 is what reproduces the high-FPS 2.1 behaviour.

slope-physics-21.name: 2.1 Slope Physics
slope-physics-21.description: Re-enables 2.1 slope behaviour (catapulting, slope clipping, etc.). Disable to keep 2.2 slopes.

preserve-21-bugs.name: Preserve 2.1 Bugs
preserve-21-bugs.description: Keeps known 2.1 physics quirks/bugs that levels like Warcora rely on (corner snap, wave hitbox slice, gravity portal seam, etc.).

log-physics.name: Verbose Physics Log
log-physics.description: Spam the Geode console with per-frame velocity/position info (debug only).
